summary: Mostly no. MACD crosses on 4h and daily candles did the same as random, and so did holding while the MACD line sat above or below its signal line, on every timeframe. The result that holds up is small: on 1h, while the pair was below its 200-day SMA, price fell after a cross down through the signal line by 0.09% more than after random candles, 20 candles later.

verdicts.use: Going long on a cross up through the signal line
verdicts.text: Beat random by 0.1% on 1h, but only at 20 candles. At 10, 50 and 100 candles, and on 4h and daily, it did the same as random.

verdicts.use: Shorting a cross down through the signal line
verdicts.text: Beat random by 0.08% on 1h at 20 candles only, and did the same as random on 4h and daily. On 1h below the 200-day SMA the gap was 0.09%, and it held without its strongest stretch and at 10 candles.

verdicts.use: MACD above or below signal as a trend filter
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, long above the signal line or short below it.
The cross up did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily.

notes: On 1h, the MACD line crossing up through the signal line gave 6,179 entries in 3,614 separate moves. Twenty candles later price was 0.1% ahead of random entries, just past a luck band of -0.08% to 0.08%. At 10, 50 and 100 candles it was inside the band. In uptrends the gap was 0.13%, still at 20 candles only. In downtrends it was 0.05%, the same as random. On BTC alone it rested on signals on Jul 23–27, 2021, and on SOL it did the same as random.

The short side is where MACD carried something. Across all conditions, price fell after a 1h cross down by 0.08% more than after random candles, at 20 candles only. While the pair was below its 200-day SMA, the gap was 0.09% against a band of -0.07% to 0.07%. It held without its strongest stretch, signals on Nov 7–8, 2022 during the FTX collapse, and showed at 10 candles too. In uptrends the same short gave 0.07%, and that rested on signals on May 22, 2021.

Holding while the MACD line stays above the signal line enters on almost every other candle: 80,901 entries on 1h. Price after those candles was 0.01% behind random, inside the band, and the short below the signal line landed in the same place. On daily, above the signal line in uptrends looked better at 2.39%, but it rested on 141 entries between Mar 28, 2021 and Nov 10, 2021. Without that stretch it was the same as random.

On daily candles the cross up split by regime and the halves cancelled out. Pooled, it was 0.14% from random, inside the band. In uptrends it did 3.94% worse than random, resting on 4 entries between Dec 2, 2021 and Jan 15, 2022. In downtrends it beat random by 4.02% at 20 days and nowhere else. The daily cross down in downtrends did 3.5% worse than random, but one signal on Dec 28, 2022 carried it.

A signal length of 5 fires about a third more often than the default: 8,024 crosses up on 1h against 6,179. More signals did not help. MACD(12,26,5) did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. On daily SOL it beat random by 4.38%, but only because of signals between Dec 26, 2022 and Jan 2, 2023.

For a long DCA bot, a MACD cross start condition times entries no better than a random candle on these pairs, so the take profit and DCA orders do the work. The one shape worth testing is a 1h short bot that requires a cross down while price is below the 200-day SMA, as one filter beside your other conditions. The 0.09% gap is small and gone by 50 candles, so a take profit that needs longer than 20 candles is waiting on price, not on MACD. In an uptrend, the same cross down showed nothing that holds.
